notes.title: NEW SHOPPING MALL MAP AND NEIGHBORHOOD REMAKE
notes.content:
[h2]NEW MAP: SHOPPING MALL[/h2]
This brand new map is a three story shopping mall, it's big and best played with a full lobby!

[h2]MAP REMAKE: NEIGHBORHOOD[/h2]
The original neighborhood map has been remade from the ground up, it is now bigger, has better gameplay flow and almost all houses are enterable!

[h2]OTHER CHANGES[/h2]
Increased human stamina
Improved settings menu
Fixed bugs

notes.title: Human gameplay overhaul, changes since launch and future updates.
notes.content:
[h2][b]THANK YOU![/b][/h2]
First of all I would like to thank each and every one of you for giving my little game a chance.
The early access launch surpassed all my expectations, you guys have literally changed my life and knowing that so many people are having fun with something I've created fills me with joy!

[h2][b]HUMAN GAMEPLAY OVERHAUL[/b][/h2]
This new update overhauls the human gameplay loop, altars have been replaced with demonic spirals which humans can find and destroy using the new crucifix item.

[h2][b]CHANGES SINCE LAUNCH[/b][/h2]
It's been three weeks since the game was launched in early access, for those who haven't played in a while here's a list of all the changes made:
[list]
[*] Added support for up to 5 players
[*] Improved the lobby system
[*] Added rematch option
[*] Added crouch for the Entity
[*] Added proximity voice chat
[*] Added new human model
[*] Added new supermarket map
[/list]

[h2][b]FUTURE UPDATES[/b][/h2]
Many amazing and spooky new things are coming, here are a few things right around the corner:
[list]
[*] An abandoned hospital map
[*] A big quality of life update
[*] UI overhaul
[*] New mannequin model
[*] New mode
[*] Sound and music overhaul
[/list]

notes.title: Update notes for October 25
notes.content:
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New experimental map (If you want to try it out press M exactly 3 times in the main menu BEFORE hosting)
[*] New character model for human players
[*] Mannequins can no longer body block or trap humans
[*] Fixed a bug that wouldn't allow matches to end
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[/list]

notes.title: DON'T LOOK AWAY - NOW OUT IN EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:

My name is Dan, I'm the sole developer of this game and I'm super excited to finally let you all play DON'T LOOK AWAY!

Stay tuned, many updates will be coming out one after another starting with 2v1 and a new map, I hope to see many of you in game!
